  "title": "Butter Crunch",
  "summary": "Butter Crunch is a focused, satisfying tactile interaction game. The player spawns in front of a clean countertop display featuring a pristine stick of butter resting on a cutting board. Clicking or tapping the butter triggers a crunchy squish animation, pops butter crumb particles, plays a synchronized crisp crunch sound from the Creator Store, and increments a clear on-screen counter from 0 up to 10 and beyond. Overlapping inputs are debounced so each crunch is distinct and counts exactly once. After each crunch animation completes, the butter smoothly recovers to its intact state, ready for the next interaction.",
  "visualDirection": "Bright, clean, cozy kitchen studio aesthetic. Warm ambient lighting (soft golden tones, gentle sunbeam effect) illuminating a polished wooden cutting board resting atop a clean pastel countertop stage. The butter stick has a smooth, rich golden-yellow hue. On click/tap, the butter squishes downward with dynamic elasticity, emitting golden particle flecks, accompanied by a crisp audio crunch. The HUD is clean and centered, featuring a bold, rounded counter display with an animated scale-bounce upon each increment.",
  "assetStrategy": "Audio is sourced strictly from Creator Store / Marketplace with required: true for the crunch sound effect. Visual food props (butter mesh/model and cutting board) are queried from Marketplace first with procedural fallbacks if external meshes are unavailable. The counter UI, camera framing, stage geometry, squish tweening, and particle bursts are procedurally authored in Luau.",
